description: A synthetic descriptor (NOT real bytes) used to exercise the local fallback store's single-object limit refusal. The declared_size_bytes exceeds the 1 MiB single-object limit, so the fallback must refuse with WAIT_STORAGE. This file is a small JSON descriptor; the oversized payload it describes is never materialized on disk. The declared digest is a deterministic placeholder (sha256 of the string 'oversized-placeholder') used only so the descriptor is self-consistent in shape.
